questions.input: When does the odd semester start and end at Greenfield Institute of Technology?
questions.expected_output: The odd semester runs from 4 August to 20 December.

questions.input: When does the even semester start and end?
questions.expected_output: The even semester runs from 12 January to 30 May.

questions.input: During which week are mid-semester tests conducted?
questions.expected_output: Mid-semester tests are held in the 8th week of each semester.

questions.input: What are the regular class timings, and when is the lunch break?
questions.expected_output: Classes run from Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 4:30 pm. The lunch break is from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm.

questions.input: Is Saturday attendance compulsory, and what activities are scheduled on Saturdays?
questions.expected_output: Saturday attendance is optional. Saturday is reserved for clubs and sports.

questions.input: What is the annual B.Tech tuition fee, and how is it divided into instalments?
questions.expected_output: The annual B.Tech tuition fee is Rs 1,20,000. It is paid in two instalments of Rs 60,000 each, due on 10 August and 15 January.

questions.input: What is the late tuition payment charge per day, and what is the maximum penalty?
questions.expected_output: The late tuition payment charge is Rs 100 per day after the due date, up to a maximum penalty of Rs 3,000.

questions.input: What happens if a student delays tuition payment by more than 30 days?
questions.expected_output: A student who is more than 30 days late cannot attend classes until the outstanding dues are paid.

questions.input: What percentage of tuition fees is refunded if a student withdraws within 7 days of classes starting?
questions.expected_output: A student who withdraws within 7 days of classes starting receives a 75 percent tuition fee refund.

questions.input: What CGPA must a student maintain to continue receiving a merit scholarship?
questions.expected_output: A student must maintain a CGPA of at least 8.0 to continue receiving a merit scholarship.

questions.input: What is the minimum attendance percentage required to sit for end-semester examinations?
questions.expected_output: A student must have at least 75 percent attendance in each course to sit for the end-semester examination.

questions.input: What happens if a student arrives more than 10 minutes late to class?
questions.expected_output: A student arriving more than 10 minutes after the class starts is marked absent for that class.

questions.input: Can a student with 60% attendance apply for attendance condonation?
questions.expected_output: No. Students with attendance below 65 percent cannot apply for condonation. They must repeat the course.

questions.input: What documents are required for medical leave, and within how many days must they be submitted?
questions.expected_output: A medical certificate from a registered doctor is required. It must be submitted within 7 days of returning to class.

questions.input: How are the 100 marks of a course divided between internal assessment and the end-semester examination?
questions.expected_output: Each course carries 100 marks. Internal assessment accounts for 40 marks, while the end-semester examination accounts for 60 marks. Internal assessment consists of two mid-semester tests worth 15 marks each and 10 marks for assignments and quizzes.

questions.input: What are the minimum marks required to pass a course overall and in the end-semester examination?
questions.expected_output: A student needs at least 40 percent overall and at least 35 percent in the end-semester examination to pass a course.

questions.input: What grade and grade points does a student receive for scoring 85 marks?
questions.expected_output: A student scoring 85 marks receives an A+ grade worth 9 grade points.

questions.input: How many days before examinations are hall tickets issued, and what conditions must students satisfy to receive them?
questions.expected_output: Hall tickets are issued 7 days before examinations. Students must have cleared their fees and meet the minimum 75 percent attendance requirement.

questions.input: What is the supplementary examination fee, and how many attempts are allowed for a course?
questions.expected_output: The supplementary examination fee is Rs 800 per course. A student is allowed a maximum of 3 attempts for any course.

questions.input: How many books can an undergraduate student borrow, and for how many days?
questions.expected_output: Undergraduate students can borrow 4 books for 14 days.

questions.input: What is the library late fine per day per book?
questions.expected_output: The library late fine is Rs 5 per day per book. The total fine cannot exceed the price of the book.

questions.input: What happens if a student loses a library book?
questions.expected_output: A student who loses a library book must pay the current price of the book plus Rs 200 as a processing fee.

questions.input: How many pages can students print per day using the digital library?
questions.expected_output: Students are allowed to print a maximum of 50 pages per day.

questions.input: What are the hostel fees for single, double and triple rooms per semester?
questions.expected_output: The hostel fee is Rs 52,000 per semester for a single room, Rs 40,000 for a double room and Rs 32,000 for a triple room. These fees include electricity and Wi-Fi.

questions.input: How much is the refundable hostel security deposit, and when is it returned?
questions.expected_output: The refundable hostel security deposit is Rs 10,000, paid once at admission. It is returned within 30 days after the student vacates the room and the warden has inspected it.

questions.input: What are the hostel gate closing times from Sunday to Thursday and on Friday and Saturday?
questions.expected_output: The hostel gate closes at 9:30 pm from Sunday to Thursday and at 10:30 pm on Friday and Saturday.

questions.input: How many nights of hostel leave can a student take per semester without a parental letter?
questions.expected_output: A student can take up to 12 nights of hostel leave per semester without a letter from parents.

questions.input: On which days is non-vegetarian food served in the hostel mess?
questions.expected_output: Non-vegetarian food is served on Wednesdays and Sundays at a separate counter.

questions.input: What CGPA and other conditions are required for placement eligibility?
questions.expected_output: A student needs a CGPA of at least 6.5, no active backlogs and at least 75 percent attendance to be eligible for placements.

questions.input: How many hours of pre-placement training must students complete, and what is the minimum attendance requirement?
questions.expected_output: Every student must complete 30 hours of pre-placement training in aptitude and communication, with at least 90 percent attendance.

questions.input: What happens if a student accepts a placement offer of Rs 8 lakh or more per year?
questions.expected_output: A student who accepts an offer of Rs 8 lakh or more per year cannot sit for any further placement drives.

questions.input: How long is the mandatory internship after the sixth semester, and how many academic credits does it carry?
questions.expected_output: Every student must complete an 8-week internship after the 6th semester. The internship carries 4 academic credits.

questions.input: How much does the college bus pass cost per semester, and what is the late renewal fee?
questions.expected_output: The college bus pass costs Rs 6,000 per semester. Renewing the pass after 15 August carries a late fee of Rs 200.

questions.input: How much does a replacement student ID card cost, and how many working days does it take?
questions.expected_output: A replacement student ID card costs Rs 200 and takes 3 working days. It must be applied for at the administration office.

questions.input: How much high-speed Wi-Fi data does each student receive monthly, and what happens after the limit is exhausted?
questions.expected_output: Each student receives 50 GB of high-speed Wi-Fi data per month at up to 200 Mbps. After using 50 GB, the speed is reduced to 2 Mbps, but the connection is not blocked.

questions.input: What is the annual accident insurance coverage provided to every student?
questions.expected_output: Every student is covered by accident insurance of Rs 2,00,000 per year, included in the tuition fee. Insurance claims must be filed within 15 days.

questions.input: What are the penalties for smoking or drinking alcohol on campus for the first, second and third offences?
questions.expected_output: The first offence carries a fine of Rs 5,000, the second offence carries a fine of Rs 10,000, and the third offence results in suspension for one semester.

questions.input: What happens to a student caught ragging another student?
questions.expected_output: A student found ragging is suspended immediately, and the case is referred to the Anti-Ragging Committee in Block A, room 12.

questions.input: Within how many working days does the institute acknowledge a grievance submitted through the ERP?
questions.expected_output: The institute acknowledges a grievance within 2 working days. The grievance is resolved within 15 working days.

questions.input: How many members are there in the Disciplinary Committee, and who are they?
questions.expected_output: The Disciplinary Committee has 5 members: the Dean of Students, two faculty members, one student representative and one hostel warden.
